newsitem.title: MEXICO: RESEARCH ALERT - GCC raised to buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - GCC raised to buy.

text.p: Flemings Research on Friday upgraded Mexican cement comany Grupo Cementos de Chihuahua SA de CV (GCC) to buy from long-term buy.

Analyst Ben Uglow said that although GCC's first-quarter earnings report was "somewhat weaker than expected" because of cost increases affecting the Mexican cement industry, the investment rating is being upgraded "due to attractive valuations".
"The 28.2 percent decrease in the stock price since its high point on Sept. 24 accomodates the new outlook, in our opinion," Uglow wrote.
Despite a 54.4 percent fall in EPS and a higher level of net debt, "the balance sheet remains strong," Uglow said.
He said the sharp drop in the stock price was considered a buying opportunity "and it is believed GCC can continue to grow its business successfully as Mexican demand recovers".
